title: 25 Rain Lily Lane Vacation Rental
meta_description: 25 Rain Lily Lane is a 6.00 bedroom, 5.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pool Passes Included (Maximum Allotted Wristband Qty is 14) 6 Seater Electric Cart Included 6 Adult Bikes Included Propane Gas Grill Outdoor Fireplace Parking for 3 Vehicles 4 Minute Walk to WaterColor Frog Pool 5 Minute Bike Ride to Camp WaterColor 7 Minute Golf Cart Ride to Seaside 4 Minute Bike Ride to Watercolor Beach Club Access DETAILS:Experience the perfect blend of luxury and coastal charm at 25 Rain Lily Lane, ideally situated in the heart of WaterColor’s prestigious Lake District. Thoughtfully designed for large families and group gatherings, this three-story retreat offers exceptional spaces for relaxation, connection, and fun — all just steps from WaterColor’s world-class amenities. Inside, the expansive living area immediately captivates with rich wood flooring, soaring beamed ceilings, and an abundance of natural light that creates a warm, inviting atmosphere. The open-concept layout seamlessly connects the gourmet kitchen, dining, and living spaces, setting the perfect stage for effortless entertaining and memorable family moments. The chef’s kitchen is a true masterpiece, featuring elegant quartzite countertops, professional-grade appliances, a beverage refrigerator, and a stand-alone ice maker — making gatherings of any size a breeze. A cozy secondary living area with a fireplace provides an intimate retreat, ideal for curling up with a good book or unwinding after a day spent exploring. The first floor hosts a beautifully appointed king suite with a private bathroom and walk-in shower, while the second floor offers three additional king bedrooms, each with its own private en suite bath and sleek walk-in shower. Step outside to the second-story covered porch, where a swinging bench and an outdoor fireplace create the perfect setting for peaceful mornings or evenings under the stars. The third floor features two thoughtfully designed bunk rooms, each offering a queen bed in addition to a full-over-full bunk bed, comfortably sleeping up to six guests per room. A secondary lounge space makes this the ultimate hangout for kids and teens alike. To help you experience everything WaterColor and 30A have to offer, the home includes six adult bikes and a six-seater electric cart, perfect for cruising to Camp WaterColor’s lazy river and pools, the newly expanded Beach Club, or the charming shops and restaurants that line iconic 30A. As a guest of WaterColor, you’ll enjoy access to a remarkable collection of amenities, including seven resort-style pools, tennis courts, playgrounds, miles of scenic nature trails, and the Boathouse offering kayak and paddleboard rentals on Western Lake. Whether you're starting your day with a bike ride along the Timpoochee Trail or ending it with a sunset cocktail at the Beach Club, every moment at 25 Rain Lily Lane invites you to relax, explore, and create lasting memories. With luxurious finishes, incredible amenities, and a prime location in the heart of the Lake District, 25 Rain Lily Lane is designed to turn your next vacation into an experience you’ll treasure for a lifetime. Let the Sanders Beach Rentals team help you bring your perfect WaterColor escape to life.
